cards.title: Chinese Hackers Breach ConnectWise Using AI Agents
cards.body: Microsoft identified China-aligned hackers who breached IT giant ConnectWise and used AI agents to rapidly infiltrate thousands of customer systems. The incident highlights emerging threats from AI-powered attack automation.

cards.title: Uber Deploys ChatGPT Work Company-Wide
cards.body: Uber expanded its ChatGPT Work deployment from a limited pilot to all 30,000 employees globally. The ride-share giant is betting on enterprise AI agents for workforce productivity.

cards.title: Spotify Positions Itself for AI Agents
cards.body: Co-CEO Gustav Söderström outlined Spotify's strategy to become the music service AI agents choose. The company sees opportunity in the emerging AI agent economy.

cards.title: Claude Duet: Anthropic's Agent Bet
cards.body: Anthropic launched Claude Duet, available via waitlist for Pro and Max plan users. The app represents the company's entry into AI agent products.

cards.title: Nirva Raises $33M for AI Pendant
cards.body: Nirva secured funding for its $249 ambient AI pendant that only listens to the user. The device ships by year-end.

cards.title: DeepSeek Raises $15B After US Ban
cards.body: DeepSeek raised $15 billion days after the U.S. ordered federal agencies to remove its technology over national security concerns. The funding round is among China's largest.

cards.title: Blackstone: AI Debt Fears Overblown
cards.body: Blackstone's AI head Jas Khaira dismissed concerns about AI infrastructure buildout debt. The PE giant remains confident despite market jitters.

cards.title: Meta Plans New Stock Class for AI
cards.body: Meta announced plans for a new stock structure to fund its expanding AI model and infrastructure investments. The strategy aims to finance the company's broad AI buildout.

cards.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
cards.body: TechCrunch Founder Summit returns November 4 in Boston with founders, VCs, and entrepreneurs sharing scaling insights. The full-day event connects early-stage to mature companies.

cards.title: Meta Muse Exceeds 10M Users
cards.body: Meta's Muse AI app surpassed 10 million users with shopping emerging as a top activity. The platform is also driving personal productivity adoption.

cards.title: Recursive Launches Flint Coding Model
cards.body: Recursive released Flint, a free laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system. The release tests AI's ability to improve itself.

cards.title: Walmart Welcomes AI Shopping Agents
cards.body: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart introduced technology enabling AI agents to make purchases with spending controls and transaction approvals. The move positions Walmart competitively in agent commerce.

cards.title: Critical PHP Vulnerabilities Found by AI
cards.body: OpenAI and Google's Wiz discovered ancient PHP security holes that AI could both prevent and exploit. The findings highlight dual-use risks in AI-powered security.

cards.title: Blacksmith Hits Unicorn Valuation
cards.body: Blacksmith secured a $66 million Series C led by Sequoia, reaching $1 billion valuation. The platform helps companies build and test AI code more effectively.

cards.title: Managers Struggle with AI Adoption
cards.body: Over 50% of managers report difficulty evaluating employee work after AI adoption, according to a new survey. AI-driven productivity gains are creating management challenges.

cards.title: Anthropic Proposes AI Safety Bill
cards.body: Anthropic pitched an AI safety policy requiring 50+ potential deaths to block model release without judicial approval. The proposal aims to balance safety with innovation.

cards.title: Hugging Face CEO Questions Netflix Doc
cards.body: Hugging Face co-founder Clem Delangue criticized Netflix's 'AI Gone Rogue' documentary for going "full doomer mode" and inaccuracy. He appeared in the film and questioned its portrayal.

cards.title: Anthropic's Cloud Compute Struggles
cards.body: Anthropic reportedly faces challenges securing compute from cloud providers who view it as competition. The infrastructure crunch comes ahead of the planned November IPO.

cards.title: SpaceX AI Business Drives Profitability
cards.body: SpaceX hit profitability in Q3 with $4.4 billion net income, powered by AI growth. The business segment exceeded company expectations.

cards.title: OpenAI Acquires Orchestra Bio
cards.body: OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio's team and technology to advance Rosalind, its life sciences AI model. The acquisition strengthens OpenAI's biotech capabilities.

cards.title: Making the case for context-aware AI
cards.body: Enterprise AI can generate recommendations and automate tasks, but without understanding how a business actually operates, even powerful models miss critical constraints. Context-aware systems that grasp organizational relationships are essential for making decisions that truly work.

cards.title: AI's hidden storage bill: What inference leaves behind
cards.body: While GPU costs dominate AI spending conversations, data storage expenses for inference operations are often overlooked. The backend data generated after model responses creates significant hidden costs that executives need to account for.

cards.title: OpenAI's latest AI models coming to Google Cloud
cards.body: OpenAI's newest AI models are being integrated into Google Cloud and Antigravity platforms. This expansion increases enterprise access to advanced AI capabilities across multiple cloud providers.

cards.title: The $15 billion ad-powered AI startup your doctor uses
cards.body: A major ad-powered AI startup valued at $15 billion is already embedded in healthcare systems. The company is quietly powering AI tools that doctors rely on daily.
